prediction.raw: To make Kraft mac and cheese, follow these steps: 1. **Prepare the Pasta:** - Boil macaroni in salted water until al dente. - Drain the pasta and set it aside. 2. **Make the Cheese Sauce:** - Melt butter in a pan. - Add flour to create a roux, stirring continuously. - Gradually pour in milk while stirring to avoid lumps. - Add cheese and stir until melted and smooth. - Season with salt and pepper to taste. 3. **Combine Pasta and Sauce:** - Mix the cooked macaroni with the cheese sauce until well coated. - Adjust the consistency by adding more milk or flour as needed. 4. **Optional Add-ins:** - Consider adding cooked bacon bits or vegetables like broccoli for extra flavor and nutrition. 5. **Serve:** - Serve hot, optionally with crackers or a salad on the side. Enjoy your homemade Kraft mac and cheese!
